allowedResources: A JDK 25 and Apache Maven 3.9 with the pinned Spring Boot 4.1.2 dependencies downloaded before the timed work (the platform template, or mvn -q dependency:go-offline); no external database, network or AI service is needed during the timed work
Any further resource rule (course pages, documentation, notes) is set and shown by the platform assessment owner
instructions: Final Assessment coding challenge, Spring (basic, 10 minutes from the end of setup, reading included). Complete GET /api/tools/{id}: ToolService.byId returns the tool or throws ToolNotFoundException, the controller returns the provided ToolResponse DTO, and the global @RestControllerAdvice ApiErrors maps ToolNotFoundException (from any controller) to a 404 ProblemDetail with title 'Tool not found' and the exception message as detail. Run mvn -q -o test in starter/; the score is the share of the 5 checks that pass, pass mark 70%.
